context: Recent (2025-2026) literature on UAV multispectral crop / weed segmentation and NDVI-based stress classification. Use as a reference frame for the deployed model's 81.40% 3-class mIoU and 96.62% per-pixel severity accuracy on WeedsGalore.

positioning: Direct apples-to-apples: WeedsGalore-WACV DeepLabv3+/MSI 82.90% (3-class) is the canonical headline; ours sits 1.5 pp below at lower compute and with three regression heads bolted on.
Lightweight comparator: the 2025 8.7 M-param transformer-CNN hybrid hits 78.88% on the same split; ours beats it by 2.5 pp.

Multi-task uniqueness: only WeedSense is similarly multi-task (seg + regression + classification), but it is RGB-only on a private dataset. No published WeedsGalore baseline jointly predicts seg + NDVI + NDRE + canopy regression.
Stress-classification framing: published baselines on hyperspectral data sit at 83-98% accuracy; ours hits 96.62% per-pixel severity accuracy as one of four jointly trained heads.
Open gap to flag: WeedsGalore 6-class is still wide open (DeepLabv3+ only 55.52% mIoU).
